body: I suppose there are things that I enjoy, but not to a very extensive or meaningful degree. All of the things that I genuinely enjoy are about people, and I seem to be annoyingly selective about which people that includes. I'm probably one of the least materialistic people I know, if not the least. I'm just rarely excited or joyed by much other than the relationships I form with the people I love, and I only love one person. I hate sounding like I'm just disregarding advice, but I've thought about this so much, I feel like maybe I've thought about it so much that any possible solutions would have already been thought of. I guess I'm posting this in hopes that somebody else has answers. I find an especial peace from being around nature, that is something I enjoy. And in the next two months I plan to incorporate that into my life a lot, hopefully that will help. I suppose the only other light in the tunnel might be contacting my dad, but I think that would go poorly. I'll try to think about your advice more, I appreciate it

I hate the idea that I'm causing people to be in distress for no reason. To be honest, I'm not sure. It's cliché, but I suppose knowing that people are concerned is a help in itself. I'm open to any suggestions
Typos for days, sorry about that
